decisions.statement: A setting is read from the character scope or from the account scope.
The account-wide scope and the character scope have the same setting names.
A saved variable table is read the first time a setting is asked for.
The game's own saved variable constructors are wrapped rather than replaced.
A setting equal to the default is dropped as the player logs out.
A dropped default is put back where the logout is cancelled.
A version number rises only once the settings that version renames have moved.
An addon switches scope through a checkbox this library hands that addon.
A migration leaves the table the migration read from empty.
A table is iterated raw only where LibLua5.2 is loaded.

definition: one addon's settings kept per character, per account or per server
